The generated tier catches up with the API's 1.10 line — the OAuth
authorization server, reconciling items on the close, and the removal that
came with them. This release names that removal, and nothing on the stable
tier changes shape.

## Removed from `/sdk`: the REST MCP tool surface

`listMcpTools` and `callMcpTool`, with the types `McpToolCall`,
`McpToolsResponse` and their `Data` / `Error` / `Responses` companions, are
gone. The API removed `GET /v1/graphs/{graph_id}/mcp/tools` and
`POST …/mcp/call-tool` in 1.10.2: MCP clients speak the Streamable HTTP
transport directly — `POST /v1/graphs/{graph_id}/mcp` with the same
`X-API-Key`, or the OAuth-only `POST /v1/mcp` — and thirty days of production
traffic showed no caller on the REST pair. No facade wrapped them, so this
reaches you only through `/sdk` — the generated tier, which tracks the API
surface and moves with it on minors. If you did call them, the replacement is
a JSON-RPC `tools/list` or `tools/call` against the same graph URL.

## New on `/sdk`: connected apps

`listUserOAuthGrants` and `revokeUserOAuthGrant`
(`GET` / `DELETE /v1/user/oauth/grants`), with `OAuthGrantInfo` and
`OAuthGrantsResponse`. A grant is one OAuth consent — one MCP client on one
graph. The listing shows the client, the graph it reaches, the MCP URL its
tokens are bound to, and when it was last used; revoking one kills every token
minted from it, so the client fails at its next call and has to ask the user
again. Until now the only way to revoke a connection was a password change,
which revoked all of them.

## New on `/sdk`: reconciling items

`previewReconcilingItem` and `resolveReconcilingItem`
(`POST /extensions/roboledger/{graph_id}/operations/preview-reconciling-item`
and `…/resolve-reconciling-item`), with `ReconcilingItemPlan`,
`ReconcilingItemDeltaLine`, `ReconcilingItemCatchUp`,
`ReconcilingItemRegenerated`, `ResolveReconcilingItemRequest` /
`Response` and their operation envelopes. A reconciling item is a posted
event whose source payload changed afterwards — a difference between the books
and the source system that nobody has dispositioned. `FiscalCalendarResponse`
gains `reconciling_item_count` and `reconciling_item_sample` (up to five
identifiers) so a blocked close names what is holding it;
`ClosePeriodOperation` and `BackfillPlanHistoryOperation` gain
`allow_reconciling_items` to close over them knowingly, which the close audit
note records. The generated GraphQL types gain the matching
`reconcilingItemCount` and `reconcilingItemSample` fields.

## Also

- `DeleteSubgraphOp.backup_first` now says what the backup is: a full dump
  registered on the parent graph's backup list, downloadable after the
  subgraph is gone — and a failed backup aborts the delete.
- `CreateEventBlock`'s description states how a `journal_entry_recorded`
  event decides whether to write back to a connected source system, and when
  to set `metadata.publish_to_source` to false.

Nothing is deprecated. `robosystems-app` consumes `/sdk` directly; its build
is the place the removal would surface first, and it never called the pair.
